description: This file contains Kotlin source code for the AssistantLaunch feature in an Android application. It defines constants, an enumeration for home destinations, a data class to encapsulate assistant launch requests, and a function to parse intents related to assistant launching.

classes.name: HomeDestination
classes.description: Enumeration representing various destinations within the app's home environment, such as Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen, and Settings.

classes.name: AssistantLaunchRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the parameters for launching the assistant, including source, prompt, and autoSend fields.

methods.name: parseAssistantLaunchIntent
methods.description: Function that interprets an Android Intent to determine if it signifies an assistant launch request, returning an AssistantLaunchRequest object if applicable.
